title: Frozen MRI prior with site-calibrated Mirror codes

prior_art.PA302: VarNet is a multi-coil unrolled network with sensitivity maps and explicit k-space consistency.
prior_art.PA305: D2SA uses patient-level distribution adaptation and slice-level test-time state.
prior_art.assets: No acquired MRI, fastMRI VarNet checkpoint, or released D2SA training checkpoint is present in this workspace. This is a synthetic mechanism screen, not a VarNet reproduction.

hypothesis: Across three held-out synthetic scanner sites with altered coil maps and sampling protocols, one site-specific Givens coordinate on a frozen multi-coil reconstruction prior will retain target anatomy quality within 1% NMSE of ordinary FiLM site calibration, save at least 25% actual deployment bytes over FiLM codes and 50% over independent per-site fine-tuning, and preserve held-out measurement consistency.
physical_object: one frozen shared multi-coil reconstruction prior
mirror_coordinate: two per-site Givens angles conjugating the four-channel latent regularizer
logical_multiplicity: one calibrated prior view per scanner site
private_boundary: independent full prior per site is upper control; all private tensors are charged

data.type: analytic synthetic complex phantoms, 2-coil SENSE acquisition
data.protocol_shift: site-specific variable-density Cartesian sampling plus analytic sensitivity-map amplitude/phase/geometry changes; operator maps are given to all conditions
data.adaptation: support and heldout acquired k-space partitions; fully sampled target truth is evaluation-only

controls: shared prior plus 2-angle site-specific Givens Mirror
independent full-prior self-supervised fine-tuning per site

training.source_pretraining: supervised on site 0 synthetic source phantoms
training.support_adaptation: 48 updates per site using four support cases and acquired train partition
training.private_upper: 48 updates per site across support cases
training.selection: one fixed protocol; no fresh access or post-development tuning

metrics: image NMSE / PSNR / global magnitude-SSIM proxy
actual complete multi-site serialized inference payload bytes

storage.common_schema: same model/site metadata and outer keys for all site packs
paid: all per-site coordinates or private weights

success_gate: Mirror is no more than 1% worse in NMSE than FiLM and independent fine-tune, saves at least 25% complete bytes versus FiLM and 50% versus independent, and heldout k-space RMSE is no more than 1.1x FiLM. SSIM is reported descriptively.
failure_gate: FAIL if Mirror misses the quality or storage gates, loses to a simpler FiLM coordinate at comparable bytes/compute, or fails heldout measurement consistency.
boundaries: Synthetic mechanism only; no fastMRI/acquired scanner data, trained VarNet, D2SA weights, or clinical claim.
Three analytic OOD site maps and one anatomy generator do not establish real scanner generalization.
No capacity claim from a fixed-update synthetic screen.
failure_gate_result: FAIL: Mirror NMSE .70081 is 11.0% worse than frozen shared prior (.63129); actual complete three-site payload saves only 64 B (1.16%) vs FiLM, below 25% gate. It does beat FiLM and private fine-tuning on this synthetic screen, but neither code adaptation improves frozen quality. Fresh remains sealed.

compute.fft: 2-coil forward FFT per reconstruction; TTA backprop costs additional compute
compute.note: Independent full-tune upper was updated on one support example per update (cycling four), while code methods used all four examples per update; equal optimizer steps but unequal support-example exposure.

amendment_01.reason: The first execution reported NMSE, PSNR and heldout residual but omitted the preregistered global magnitude-SSIM calculation. This amendment adds only that score-only metric to the final deterministic replay; model, data, optimization, selection, gates and fresh-seed policy are unchanged. SSIM is descriptive and not used for tuning or the decision gate.
